sloka: नूनं राक्षसकन्यानां रुदन्तीनां गृहे गृहे ।श्रोष्यामि नचिरादेव दुःखार्तानाम् इह ध्वनिम् ।। ५.२४.२९।।।।
transliteration: nūnaṁ rākṣasakanyānāṁ rudantīnāṁ gṛhe gṛhe ।śroṣyāmi nacirādeva duḥkhārtānām iha dhvanim ।। 5.24.29।।।।

translations.english: O wicked Mythili! we have tolerated many unpleasant words uttered by you due to our kindness and mildness..
